Firmware sources

Add a GitHub repository. firmforge reads firmware/manifest.json from its default branch, and any manifest.json attached to its releases.

The catalogue ships empty on purpose: you choose what firmware to trust. firmforge prefers linking to a publisher's own release assets over rehosting their binaries.
